objective: Centralize ownership and collision-history rollback, remove mutable-global aliases from engine.rs and redundant tracked-length bookkeeping, preserve exact behavior and measured performance.

plan.json.goal: Simplify ownership and history bookkeeping while preserving exact behavior and measured performance.
design: Replace global mutable engine arenas and reconciliation scratch with one scoped RefCell-owned arena; keep the existing WASM ABI.
Centralize history frame boundaries, reset and rollback in one owner; derive tracked length from stored boundaries.
Make cloned history shortcuts explicitly empty, matching the line-query clone contract.
plan.json.development: Build and test pieces separately. Fixed eight-pair diagnostics after three warmups; do not promote from development timing.

finalValidation.memory: WASM high-water must not increase on fixed workloads.
finalValidation.adoption: Cleanup, not a speedup claim. Require exact structural gates, no REJECT decision in the three performance guards, and upper 95% time-delta bounds below +0.5% in engine and automatic guards. Fixed counts; no extending an inconclusive run to seek acceptance.

boundaries-plan.json.change: Use one FrameBoundary record per history frame instead of three separate offset vectors. Keep the public frame/event storage and all physics arithmetic unchanged.
boundaries-plan.json.diagnosis: Eight fixed broad-workload pairs and eight stepping pairs after three warmups, then freeze for the already-declared cleanup regression protocol.

protocol.memory: WASM high-water must not increase on fixed workloads.
